newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada Nov housing starts rise 17 pct.
newsitem.headline: Canada Nov housing starts rise 17 pct.

text.p: Canadian housing starts rose by 17.0 percent in November to a seasonally adjusted annual rate (SAAR) of 138,200 units from 118,100 in October, the Canada Mortgage and Housing Corp (CMHC) said on Monday.
A Reuter survey of economists had forecast housing starts of 127,175 units.
Actual housing starts rose to 12,139 in November from 10,531 the month before. The SAAR is a monthly figure adjusted to remove normal seasonal variations and multiplied by 12.

The housing corporation said the November housing starts level was the highest since November 1994.
"It coincides with high activity in the existing home market, which rose 13 percent to a record 347,000 sales in October," said Michel Laurence, senior economist at the CMHC Market Analysis Centre.
